plain_english_policy: Supports voluntary spending limits on candidates for state government.

effects.rationale: Voluntary spending limits are a restriction on the amount of money candidates can spend in their campaigns.

evidence_quote: "I support voluntary spending limits to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to run for office." - Candidate Statement, Year: 2010, Section: Campaign Finance and Government Reform Issues, Question: c) Do you support limits on the following types of contributions to candidates for state government? Option: d) Should candidates for state office be encouraged to meet voluntary spending limits?
